statusNote: 2026-09-15 update: S3 download authorization delivered — ServeUploadedFile now serves the s3 driver through the authorized backend route (upload.Service.OpenS3Object + EnforceTenantObjectScope); tenancy is enforced from the resolved context only, cross-tenant reads are denied before any object-store call (no existence leak), object-store errors map to not_found, and compat keeps legacy keys. 6 isolation tests added (upload_s3_download_authorization_test.go); build/vet/go test -short green. Durable-job gap disposition: no durable job framework exists in the codebase (only the operation-log in-process async queue, which preserves explicit TenantID with test evidence); contract §3.2 already mandates tenant_id propagation for any future worker — recorded as future work, not an isolation hole.
